description: The Republic of Ireland's Health Service Executive (HSE) has approved osimertinib for reimbursement as a monotherapy treatment option for the adjuvant treatment after complete tumor resection for adult patients with stae IB-IIIA non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) whose tumor has epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) exon 19 deletions (Ex19del) or exon 21 (L858R) substitution mutations.
